en.t: The handwriting was scattered and disorderly, yet it had a charming wit about it.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想起离去之前不能与此人再会一面，觉得异常可惜。

en.t: Prince Genji thought how regrettable it was that he could not meet this person once more before leaving.
But then he changed his mind:

units.source_text: 那边都是弘徽殿太后一派，痛恨源氏公子之人甚多；

en.t: Everyone over there belonged to the faction of the Kokiden Empress Dowager, and many of them bitterly hated Prince Genji;

units.source_text: 况且胧月夜也有所顾忌。

en.t: besides, Oborozukiyo also had her own reasons for caution.
So he gave up the thought of seeing her again.
